content_text: if you’re also curious about robotics hardware and don’t know a lot (like me), i found the best place to start!! this website has an interactive breakdown of literally every component in a humanoid: skeleton, motors, batteries, reducers, sensors, all the way to cost breakdowns and sourcing you can click through real robots (like boston dynamics, apollo) and watch the spec sheets update live also just a joy to use http://humanityslastmachine.com
